prompt: Edit this painting and change nothing but one shot. The cannon standing on top of the left island castle's right corner tower, the one whose barrel points to the right across the strait, fires at the right island castle: the ball flies to the right along its barrel over the strait toward the right castle. The shot: a bright yellow flash and one round white smoke cloud right at that cannon's muzzle, and one cannonball, a dark sphere about the size of the cannon's wheel, a short way out beyond the muzzle, exactly on the barrel's axis, with a faint trail back to the muzzle. The cannon itself, the direction of its barrel, the other cannons, the castles, the grid, the colours and the title all stay exactly as they are. No people, no other words, no watermark.
